headerDisplay:
Adds a momentary **Force Close** switch in HomeKit. On tap, the plugin temporarily changes ratgdo's obstruction-source setting (so the firmware ignores a sun-glare false-tripped photo eye), sends close, waits for the door to finish, then restores the setting.

_Use only when you can see the door and have confirmed nothing is in the way. Don't put this switch in an automation._
footerDisplay:
After saving, restart the Homebridge child bridge (or Homebridge itself) so the new switch shows up in the Home app.

**Need help?** See the [README](https://github.com/Haglerd/homebridge-ratgdo-forceclose#readme) for the four-step POST sequence, troubleshooting, and the safety notice.

name.title: Accessory Name
name.description: The name shown in HomeKit for this accessory.

ratgdoHost.title: ratgdo URL
ratgdoHost.description: Base URL of your ratgdo (the IP or hostname you use to access its web UI). The 'http://' prefix is added automatically if you omit it.

username.title: Username
username.description: Only required if you have enabled 'Require Password' on ratgdo's settings page. Leave blank if your ratgdo allows unauthenticated requests.

password.title: Password
password.description: Paired with Username. The plugin uses HTTP Digest authentication, which is what ratgdo's firmware uses.

settingKey.title: Setting key to toggle

oneOf.title: obstFromStatus — Get obstruction from GDO status messages (recommended)
pinBasedObst — read obstruction from sensor pin (inverse)

settingKey.description: Default matches the 'Get obstruction from GDO status messages' checkbox in ratgdo's settings. If toggling that one does not get the door to close, switch to pinBasedObst and flip the bypass/normal values below.

bypassValue.title: Value during close (bypass state)
bypassValue.description: For obstFromStatus: true means use status messages, ignore the photo-eye pin (the sun-flare false trip). For pinBasedObst: false means stop reading the pin entirely.

normalValue.title: Fallback restore value
normalValue.description: FALLBACK ONLY. The plugin reads the current obstFromStatus value during pre-flight and restores back to whatever was there — so under normal operation this field is unused. It's only consulted if the pre-flight status read fails entirely (rare). Leave at the default unless you know your pre-flight reads are unreliable.

closeWaitMs.title: Max wait for door to reach Closed (ms)
closeWaitMs.description: Upper bound on the time between Step 2 (close POST) and Step 3 (restore POST). The plugin polls garageDoorState every 500ms and proceeds as soon as the door reaches `Closed` — so this is a CEILING, not a fixed sleep. 60s default covers a typical 12s close cycle plus margin for slower doors or temporary status read failures.

postCloseSettleMs.title: Settle time after Closed before restore (ms)
postCloseSettleMs.description: After the door confirms Closed, the plugin waits this long before firing the Step 3 restore POST. Gives ratgdo's firmware a moment to settle before another flash-write that may crash/reboot it. 8s default; lower for snappier sequences, higher if you see restore POSTs failing.

bundleTtcZero.title: Bundle TTCseconds=0 with obstFromStatus flash
bundleTtcZero.description: When ON, the plugin temporarily sets ratgdo's TTCseconds (warning beep before close) to 0 in the SAME flash POST as the obstFromStatus toggle, then restores the original TTC in the same Step 3 flash POST. Costs zero extra reboots (ratgdo's setgdo handler bundles multiple keys into one flash save) but skips the ~5–10s warning-beep window so the close fires instantly after Step 2. Turn OFF only if you specifically want the warning beep during force-close.

interStepMaxWaitMs.title: Max wait for ratgdo to be ready between steps (ms)
interStepMaxWaitMs.description: After the obstFromStatus flash write reboots ratgdo, the plugin polls GET /status.json every 250ms until ratgdo is FULLY ready — meaning HTTP responds AND garageDoorState is a valid (non-Unknown) state. Real serial logs show HTTP comes back ~12s after a flash-write reboot but the wall-panel/GDO-comms layer can take ~30s; close commands sent during that window are silently dropped. 45s default covers worst case.

cooldownMs.title: Cooldown between triggers (ms)
cooldownMs.description: Minimum time between consecutive force-close triggers. Prevents fat-finger re-tapping. Set to 0 to disable, but read the safety notice in the header first.

useForceClose.title: Use forceClose handler (custom firmware)
useForceClose.description: When ON (default), the plugin sends a single POST forceClose=<ms> and the firmware does the full 2-press hold-to-close override sequence internally. Requires v3.4.4-forceclose.5+ firmware. Turn OFF only if running vanilla upstream firmware that lacks the forceClose handler — falls back to the legacy obstFromStatus toggle dance.

presentAsGarageDoor.title: Present as a HomeKit garage door tile
presentAsGarageDoor.description: When ON (default), the accessory shows up in HomeKit as a proper Garage Door Opener tile (icon, Open/Closed status, slider). Slider→Closed runs force-close, slider→Open runs a normal open. State is driven by status polling so the tile updates as the door physically moves. Turn OFF for the legacy momentary-Switch UI from v1.0.x.

forceCloseHoldMs.title: forceClose hold duration (ms)
forceCloseHoldMs.description: How long ratgdo simulates the wall-button hold when 'Use forceClose' is ON. 3500ms (3.5s) covers most GDO motors. Bump higher if the motor refuses the hold; some Sec+ 1.0 motors need 4–5s. The plugin auto-retries up to 3 times if the door doesn't start moving.

enableRebootButton.title: Add a Reboot ratgdo switch
enableRebootButton.description: Adds a separate momentary HomeKit switch that POSTs /reboot to ratgdo when tapped. Useful when ratgdo gets into a weird state and the only fix is a reboot — saves a trip to the device's web UI.

rebootCooldownMs.title: Reboot cooldown (ms)
rebootCooldownMs.description: Minimum time between consecutive reboot triggers. ratgdo takes ~30s to come back; default 60s prevents accidental double-reboots.

enableObstructionSensor.title: Add an Obstruction Contact Sensor
enableObstructionSensor.description: Adds a HomeKit ContactSensor that reflects ratgdo's obstruction state (status.json.garageObstructed). 'Open' = obstructed, 'Closed' = clear. Enable phone notifications for this sensor in iOS Home → Settings → Notifications to get alerted whenever ratgdo reports an obstruction. Updates whenever the polling loop sees a state change.

enableMotionSensor.title: Add a Motion Sensor
enableMotionSensor.description: Adds a HomeKit MotionSensor that mirrors ratgdo's motion detection (status.json.garageMotion). Useful for automations triggered by activity in the garage.

statusPollIntervalMs.title: Status polling interval (ms)
statusPollIntervalMs.description: How often the plugin reads /status.json from ratgdo to update the obstruction/motion sensors. Only runs when at least one sensor is enabled. Polling pauses during a force-close or reboot. Backs off automatically on transient connection errors.

manageDeviceSettings.title: Manage device settings from Homebridge
manageDeviceSettings.description: When ON, the plugin pushes the values from 'Device defaults' below to ratgdo's /setgdo endpoint on plugin init (one bundled flash write). Lets you centralize a few common ratgdo settings in Homebridge instead of editing them in the device's web UI. Requires a Homebridge child-bridge restart for changes to take effect (the values push on init).

deviceDefaults.title: Device defaults pushed on init
deviceDefaults.description: Optional values pushed to ratgdo when 'Manage device settings' is ON. Leave a field blank to NOT push that setting (the plugin only sends keys you actually set). Each setting has a safe range; the plugin clamps invalid values.

TTCseconds.title: Default time-to-close warning (seconds, 0–30)
TTCseconds.description: ratgdo's TTCseconds — the warning-beep window before a remote close. 0 disables the warning entirely. NOTE: per-tap force-close already temporarily sets this to 0 via 'Bundle TTCseconds=0'; this setting controls the BASELINE that normal HomeKit closes (not force-close) use.

occupancyDuration.title: Occupancy hold-time (seconds, 30–3600)
occupancyDuration.description: How long ratgdo holds 'room occupied' after the last motion event. 180s = 3 minutes (typical default).

lightHomeKit.title: Expose GDO light to HomeKit (native)
lightHomeKit.description: ratgdo's own setting for whether the GDO light appears in HomeKit as a native Lightbulb (separate from this plugin).

motionHomeKit.title: Expose ratgdo motion to HomeKit (native)
motionHomeKit.description: ratgdo's own setting for whether motion appears in HomeKit natively (separate from this plugin's optional Motion sensor above).

LEDidle.title: LED behavior when idle
LEDidle.description: ratgdo's onboard LED behavior when nothing is happening.

layout.title: Optional — Push managed device settings to ratgdo on startup
Legacy obstFromStatus mode (v1.0.x compat — only relevant when useForceClose is OFF)
layout.description: These options are ONLY used when 'Use forceClose handler' is turned OFF (i.e. you're running vanilla upstream firmware without the forceClose patch). In default mode, the firmware handles everything internally and these are ignored.
